palette.notes: Both clip sheets under the tag were e-boy fashion dance videos, not eBoy's art; the wiki does not describe the palette. Nothing measured.

lighting: Not visible here; isometric pixoramas use a fixed light direction so thousands of reused parts match.
silhouette: Every object is a modular block from a shared library of over 5,000 elements (wiki), drawn on the same isometric grid so it snaps into any city.
texture: Density is the texture: cars, robots, signs and people packed into every tile of a city; pop-culture and toy references as filler.
camera: Fixed isometric view, no perspective; works as one huge poster you pan across.

acting.acts: Tiny figures are frozen mid-action across the city, each a small story to find.
acting.depth: No depth scaling: isometric keeps every figure the same size near or far.

techniques: modular reusable parts on one isometric grid
hidden tiny stories spread across a dense scene
consistent light direction so reused parts match
feel: huge dense isometric city + tiny hidden stories = an image you search, not glance at
for_fred: Hide a tiny Fred or Pixie doing something in a busy corner of a wide shot (a 'where is Fred' beat) before cutting close; viewers who spot him get a reward on rewatch. Build Fred's props as reusable parts on one grid.
